messages:
deploy-bot: Start rollout: release=v2.9.0 mode=phased regions=[US,EU,APAC]. initial_seed: US=10%, EU=10%, APAC=0%. change_window=2026-03-22T04:00Z-06:00Z. doc=/release/3120019999
rachel: Quick capacity read: US free_gpus=95/220, EU free_gpus=42/150, APAC free_gpus=12/80 (tight). APAC should remain pinned until we can warm at least +32 GPUs.
tom: Agree pin APAC. Also note APAC auto-scaler hitting quota on a2-large-x -- getting quota errors in provisioning logs. filing INF ticket shortly.
priya: Rolling canary plan: seed US & EU at 10% -> observe 20m -> bump US to 30% if green -> then EU to 30% after 30m hold. APAC blocked until infra confirms warm capacity.
oncall: Alert thresholds set: canary_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m -> page; p95 > 450ms for 10m -> page; error_budget_burn > 30% in 10m -> page. Also alert on token_cost_per_min spike >35% (soft notify to @product).
capacity-bot: Capacity model: predicted headroom post-bump: US=20%, EU=14%, APAC=3%. risk_flag=APAC_low_headroom. snapshot_id=cap-3120019999-01.
ops: Can someone paste the smoke test we used? need to reproduce quickly if we see regressions.
tom: Smoke test snippet:
```
# burst 100 concurrent lightweight inference requests
for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -sS -X POST https://us.api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"sanity-check"}' & done
wait
```
rachel: Observability read after initial seed: US p50=40ms p95=170ms p99=360ms error_rate=0.1%. EU p50=39ms p95=165ms p99=340ms error_rate=0.12%. no 5xx seen.
priya: Proposal for rollback triggers (finalized): any one of: (1) sustained canary_5xx_rate > 1.5% for 5m, (2) p95 > 600ms for 5m, (3) queue_backpressure > 75% for 3m. If tripped -> auto-rollback and page #eng-oncall.
oncall: Echo. We'll add automated runbook link to the pager with rollback steps and console links.
ops: Manual approval requested to bump US to 30%. Approver: rachel. rachel: approved. deploy-bot: US canary increased to 30% per manual approval by rachel @3120020100.
capacity-bot: Throttle rule active: if in_flight_requests > 700 OR avg_queue_latency > 1200ms -> auto-defer and tag rollout as deferred.
tom: Small blip at +7m: one host produced OOMs on a single worker pod, restarted, no user-visible errors. host removed from pool and replaced.
rachel: Holding for +30m to validate. If green, we proceed EU->30% at +30m. APAC remains pinned and recorded in release notes.
priya: Updated release notes: pinned_regions=[APAC], canary_progression=[US:30,E U:25_pending], notes_url=https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.9.0/3120019999
ops: Created infra ticket INF-2310 for APAC quota request (needed +28 GPUs). assigning to @infra-team.
capacity-bot: Saved audit snapshot cap-3120019999-02. deploy-bot: Rollout audit entry id=3120019999 branch=main steps=[seed,monitor,manual-bump_us,hold].
priya: Reminder: any rollback must include a short rationale and attach cap-snapshot + logs in the console. paging @oncall if rollbacks happen.
ops: linking playbook https://redwood.internal/playbooks/regional-rollouts#staged-bumps for new joiners.
rachel: Thanks all. interim update at +15m. reconvene +30m for go/no-go on EU.
